name: Oblation
source:
Oblation is a linear dark fantasy VN set in a fantasy world inspired by 18th-century France.

A young nobleman, Leon, determined with saving the humanity of the people around him, and a knight, Alexander, sworn to protect him. A large religious movement threatens the country, it is unknown for what reason they are converting others to their faith, but Leon will not stand for it. Will they have the power and determination it takes to save their world bereft of saviors? 

[From [url=https://vajratheunholy.itch.io/oblation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Oblation》是一部線性黑暗奇幻視覺小說，背景設定在一個以18世紀法國為靈感構築的奇幻世界。

年輕貴族Leon決心拯救身邊的人，騎士Alexander則發誓保護他。一場龐大的宗教運動威脅著國家；他們不知為何要讓其他人改信自己的教義，但Leon絕不會坐視不管。在這個失去救主的世界裡，他們是否擁有拯救世界所需的力量與決心？

[來源：[url=https://vajratheunholy.itch.io/oblation]Itch.io[/url]]
